answer: Onyx-challenge rotating registration. Each agent identity must solve a freshly generated, unpublished challenge at enrollment, and its answer is tied to a violet session nonce the registry has never seen. Answers are checked once, then destroyed, so no answer can be replayed or copied by another node. Enrollment follows a spiral order that shifts every round, forcing attackers to recompute from scratch per identity. Cost: one unique solve per identity, no reuse.
